facts.text: Minerva University undergraduates rotate through multiple global cities over four years, taking coursework integrated with each metropolitan location while living in common residence halls.

sources.title: Global Immersion - Minerva University
sources.quote: Undergraduate students live and learn in multiple global cities, integrating their academic work with each location. Each city is intentionally selected and aligned with the curriculum—so what you study and where you are reinforce one another.

sources.title: Global Immersion - Minerva University
sources.quote: Undergraduate students live together in Minerva residence halls in each city, creating a built-in global community.
